cases.query: EVALUATE ROW("a", IFERROR("a" + 1, "bad"), "b", IFERROR(1 / 0, "bad"), "c", IFERROR(DIVIDE(1, 0), 0), "d", IFERROR(VALUE("x"), -1))
EVALUATE ROW("a", IFERROR(1, "text"), "b", IFERROR(1 / 0, 7))
EVALUATE ROW("a", ISERROR("a" + 1), "b", ISERROR(1 / 0), "c", ISERROR(SQRT(-1)), "d", ISERROR(BLANK()))
EVALUATE ROW("a", SWITCH(2, 1, "a", 2, "b", "z"), "b", SWITCH(9, 1, "a", "z"), "c", SWITCH(9, 1, "a"), "d", SWITCH(TRUE(), 5 > 10, "big", 5 > 1, "mid", "small"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", SWITCH(BLANK(), 0, "zero", BLANK(), "blank", "other"), "b", SWITCH(0, BLANK(), "blank", 0, "zero", "other"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", SWITCH("1", 1, "num", "other"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", IF(TRUE(), 1, "text"), "b", IF(FALSE(), 1, 2.5), "c", IF(FALSE(), 1), "d", IF(BLANK(), 1, 2), "e", IF(1, "yes", "no"), "f", IF("true", 1, 2))
EVALUATE ROW("a", IF.EAGER(TRUE(), 1, 2), "b", IF.EAGER(FALSE(), 1, 2))
EVALUATE ROW("and", BITAND(12, 10), "or", BITOR(12, 10), "xor", BITXOR(12, 10), "l", BITLSHIFT(1, 4), "r", BITRSHIFT(256, 4), "neg", BITLSHIFT(16, -2), "blank", BITAND(BLANK(), 1))
EVALUATE ROW("a", BITLSHIFT(1, 62), "b", BITLSHIFT(1, 63), "c", BITLSHIFT(1, 64), "d", BITAND(-1, 255))

EVALUATE ROW("n1", ISNUMBER(1), "n2", ISNUMBER("1"), "n3", ISNUMBER(DATE(2024, 1, 1)), "n4", ISNUMBER(BLANK()), "n5", ISNUMBER(TRUE()), "t1", ISTEXT("a"), "t2", ISTEXT(BLANK()), "nt", ISNONTEXT(BLANK()), "lg", ISLOGICAL(TRUE()), "lg2", ISLOGICAL(1))
EVALUATE ROW("a", ISEVEN(4), "b", ISODD(3), "c", ISEVEN(3.9), "d", ISEVEN(BLANK()), "e", ISODD(-3), "f", ISEVEN("4"))

EVALUATE ROW("a", CONTAINS(Product, Product[Color], "red"), "b", CONTAINS(Product, Product[Color], "Red", Product[Category], "Clothing"), "c", CONTAINS(Product, Product[Color], "Red", Product[Category], "Accessories"), "d", CONTAINS(Product, Product[Color], BLANK()))
EVALUATE ROW("a", CONTAINSROW({1, 2, 3}, 2), "b", CONTAINSROW({1, 2}, 5), "c", CONTAINSROW({"a"}, "A"), "d", CONTAINSROW({0}, BLANK()), "e", CONTAINSROW({BLANK()}, BLANK()))

EVALUATE ROW("a", CONTAINSSTRING("Hello World", "WORLD"), "b", CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT("Hello World", "WORLD"), "c", CONTAINSSTRING("abc", ""), "d", CONTAINSSTRING(BLANK(), "a"), "e", CONTAINSSTRING("abc", BLANK()))

EVALUATE ROW("a", LOOKUPVALUE(Product[Product], Product[ProductKey], 3), "b", LOOKUPVALUE(Product[Product], Product[ProductKey], 99, "none"), "c", LOOKUPVALUE(Product[Product], Product[ProductKey], 99))
EVALUATE ROW("a", LOOKUPVALUE(Product[Product], Product[Color], "Red"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", LOOKUPVALUE(Product[Category], Product[Color], "Red"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", CALCULATE(LOOKUPVALUE(Product[Product], Product[ProductKey], 3), Product[Color] = "Red"))
EVALUATE ROW("a", LOOKUPVALUE(Customer[Customer], Customer[CustomerKey], 99))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "one", HASONEFILTER(Product[Category]), "val", HASONEVALUE(Product[Category]), "color", HASONEFILTER(Product[Color])) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE ROW("a", USERCULTURE())
EVALUATE ROW("a", COALESCE(BLANK(), BLANK(), 3), "b", COALESCE(BLANK(), BLANK()), "c", COALESCE("", 5))
EVALUATE ROW("a", AND(TRUE(), BLANK()), "b", OR(BLANK(), FALSE()), "c", AND(1, 1), "d", NOT(0), "e", NOT(BLANK()))
